input: Schedule swim lessons for the toddler

gold.taskTitle: Schedule Swim Lessons for the Toddler
gold.taskDescription: Find and book swim lessons for a toddler, covering location, timing, format, and any specific needs.

questions.title: How old is your toddler right now?
questions.description: The child's exact age determines which lesson levels or programs they qualify for.

questions.title: Do you already have a pool or swim school in mind?
questions.description: Knowing if a location is pre-selected narrows down the search or booking steps.

questions.title: What days of the week work best for lessons?
questions.description: Identifying available days helps filter class schedules that fit the family routine.

questions.title: Do you prefer group classes or private one-on-one lessons?
questions.description: The lesson format affects cost, pacing, and the type of programs to look for.

questions.title: Is there a budget per lesson or per month in mind?
questions.description: A budget range helps narrow choices between community pools, private schools, and independent instructors.

questions.title: Should a parent or caregiver be in the water too?
questions.description: Many toddler programs require an adult in the pool; knowing this filters eligible classes.

questions.title: When do you want the first lesson to start by?
questions.description: A target start date creates a deadline for completing registration and any required paperwork.
